_note: Real Indian power-bank fires reported in the news, for the pitch, video and deck (not loaded into the recalls table: news, not regulator notices). Each was read in full from the source on 16 Oct 2026. No brand or model was named in any of them.

incidents.where: IndiGo flight 6E 6115, Delhi to Chennai, at 35,000 ft
incidents.what: A passenger's power bank caught fire in an overhead bin; crew put it out with extinguishers and the flight diverted to Hyderabad.

incidents.product: wireless power bank (about Rs 4,000-4,500, "a good company's")
incidents.where: Surat, a YouTuber's bedroom (Shivani Kapila, "Little Gloves")
incidents.what: The power bank exploded while charging; the room, AC and her YouTube Play Buttons were destroyed by fire.

incidents.where: IndiGo flight 6E-108, Hyderabad to Chandigarh, after landing at Chandigarh
incidents.what: A power bank in a seat pocket near 39C ignited and kept smouldering; about 200 passengers were evacuated down all six slides.
incidents.injuries: at least 6 hurt in the evacuation, one leg fracture needing surgery
incidents.source: The Times of India, 6 May 2026, citing the DGCA
